findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "report_confusion" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Send feedback to the QuBe Sync team about something in this server, its guides, or the v2 API that confused you, so we can fix it. Use it when a tool descriptio…

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "match_records" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Finds the record in a customer's QuickBooks company file that a name means, even written differently -- QuickBooks itself only matches a name exactly, or by 'co…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
